crossRefs.note: When the first came, they supposed that they would receive more; and they likewise each received a denarius.

translations.web: When the first came, they supposed that they would receive more; and they likewise each received a denarius.
translations.bsb: So when the original workers came, they assumed they would receive more. But each of them also received a denarius.
translations.kjv: But when the first came, they supposed that they should have received more; and they likewise received every man a penny.
translations.asv: And when the first came, they supposed that they would receive more; and they likewise received every man a shilling.
